parts.name: base body

physics.Basic_description: Matte black plastic base with a rectangular footprint and slightly tapered sides.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the stable foundation for the stapler and houses the anvil plate.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the sides of the base firmly to stabilize the object while operating the top arm.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic housing typically has thin walls to save material and weight.

parts.description: Matte black plastic base with a rectangular footprint and slightly tapered sides.

parts.name: foot pad 0

physics.Basic_description: Small black rubber pads located on the underside of the base (inferred from function).
physics.Functional_description: Prevents slipping on the desk surface and protects the table from scratches.
physics.Grasped_description: Not intended for grasping; located on the bottom surface.
physics.reason: Small rubber feet are typically solid molded pieces.

parts.name: anvil plate

physics.Basic_description: Silver-colored metal plate embedded in the top surface of the base.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a hard surface with grooves to bend the staple legs inward or outward.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and flush to grasp; part of the base assembly.
physics.reason: Metal anvil plates are solid stamped steel components.

parts.description: Silver-colored metal plate embedded in the top surface of the base.

parts.name: hinge knuckles

physics.Basic_description: Grey metal brackets at the rear connecting the base and top arm.
physics.Functional_description: Forms the pivot point allowing the top arm to rotate relative to the base.
physics.Grasped_description: Small structural component, not suitable for grasping.
physics.reason: Hinge brackets are solid metal stampings or castings for strength.

parts.description: Grey metal brackets at the rear connecting the base and top arm.
parts.function: Forms the pivot point allowing the top arm to rotate relative to the base.

parts.name: torsion spring

physics.Basic_description: Coiled metal wire spring visible at the hinge mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the restoring force to return the top arm to the open position.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal mechanism, not accessible for grasping.
physics.reason: Springs are made of solid wire.

parts.description: Coiled metal wire spring visible at the hinge mechanism.
parts.function: Provides the restoring force to return the top arm to the open position.

parts.name: arm shell

physics.Basic_description: Bright red matte plastic cover forming the main body of the upper arm.
physics.Functional_description: Encloses the internal stapling mechanism and provides a surface for the user to press.
physics.Grasped_description: Primary grasp point; grip the top surface to press down and staple.
physics.reason: Plastic shell is a thin-walled enclosure around the internal metal rail.

parts.description: Bright red matte plastic cover forming the main body of the upper arm.
parts.function: Encloses the internal stapling mechanism and provides a surface for the user to press.

parts.name: carrier rail

physics.Basic_description: Silver metal channel visible inside the top arm when open.
physics.Functional_description: Guides the staples and holds the spring-loaded pusher.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal component, usually covered by the shell during operation.
physics.reason: Stamped sheet metal channel forming a U-shape.

parts.description: Silver metal channel visible inside the top arm when open.
parts.function: Guides the staples and holds the spring-loaded pusher.

parts.name: driver blade

physics.Basic_description: Small metal block at the front tip of the internal mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: Pushes the staple out of the magazine and through the paper.
physics.reason: Small functional metal component is likely solid.

parts.description: Small metal block at the front tip of the internal mechanism.

parts.name: hinge pin

physics.Basic_description: Small cylindrical metal pin passing through the hinge knuckles.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as the axle for the hinge rotation.
physics.reason: Pins are solid metal rods.

parts.description: Small cylindrical metal pin passing through the hinge knuckles.

parts.name: grip rib 0

physics.Basic_description: Series of raised yellow-green ridges on the top rear of the red arm shell.
physics.Functional_description: Provides tactile feedback and increased friction for the user's thumb or finger.
physics.Grasped_description: Press down on these ribs to operate the stapler comfortably.
physics.reason: Ribs are likely molded integrally with the shell or as solid inserts, effectively solid features.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
